size 只使用 small、medium、large、wide；shot 只使用远景、全景、中景、近景、特写；angle 只使用平视、俯视、仰视；position 只使用左、中、右。
每格明确动作、镜头、人物位置、姿态和表情，避免一格包含多个无法同时绘制的连续动作。时间未明确时使用 null；无角色来源的旁白和拟声词的 speaker 使用 null。
审稿意见存在时，只修改意见涉及的页，保留意见中的页码与相关格 ID，不用修复意见作为添加新剧情或重排无关页的理由。同页未涉及问题的画格、对白和已确认状态保持原样，不趁修订给名单外的人物新增身份卡。

[TEXT RULES]
Render every dialogue and sound effect string quoted in the panel instructions exactly, character by character, preserving the original Chinese wording and punctuation. Never translate, correct, replace, truncate or add text.
Speech uses speech bubbles with tails pointing to the named speaker. Thought uses cloud bubbles, narration uses rectangular boxes, and sound effects use stylized lettering. A supplied short narration introducing a person's name and current identity is a compact character-introduction box BESIDE that visible person, without a speech tail. Supplied time/place narration belongs at the scene opening or transition; do not create unquoted labels.
Each bubble is limited to 15 Chinese characters and Chinese punctuation marks; each panel is limited to 2 bubbles. The supplied storyboard must already satisfy these limits; never change a quoted string to meet them.
No other text anywhere on the page. Do not print panel numbers, reference labels, IDs, instructions or watermarks. Character names may appear ONLY when included in explicitly quoted dialogue, narration or character-introduction strings, never copied from metadata. Only the explicitly specified dialogue, narration, thought and sound effect strings may appear.
